messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Mac OS help
parts:
Thanks for the report. If you run from the console you might see the error message. From other discussions here it is likely you have installed an older version of GTK - the latest version of GTK is required to run Rattle (one supporting GtkBuilder). Perhaps a newer version of Mac OS/X is required. The current GTK libraries work with Rattle on Darwin Kernel Version 13.1.0: Thu Jan 16 19:40:37 PST 2014.

Regards,
Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
